description: This file defines an Android activity called CartActivity responsible for managing the shopping cart UI, including displaying cart items, updating quantities, removing items, clearing the cart, and navigating within the app.

classes.name: CartActivity
classes.description: An Android activity managing the shopping cart UI, handling user interactions such as updating item quantities, removing items, clearing the cart, and proceeding to checkout.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and binds data to the views.

methods.name: setupToolbar
methods.description: Configures the toolbar with title and navigation icon.

methods.name: setupRecycler
methods.description: Sets up the RecyclerView with the CartAdapter and item interaction handlers.

methods.name: setupActions
methods.description: Defines click actions for buttons such as clear cart and checkout.

methods.name: bindState
methods.description: Binds ViewModel flows to UI updates, observing cart items, summary, and item count.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles toolbar menu item selections, particularly the navigation back button.
